title: Sanaṃkumāro
text: 1. Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Sappinī-tīre || || 2. Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Sappinī-tīram obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || 3. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Khattiyo seṭṭho jane tasmiṃ || ye gottapaṭisārino || vijjācaraṇasampanno || so seṭṭho devamānuse ti || || 4. Idam avoca brahmā Sanaṃkumāro || samanuñño satthā ahosi || || 5. Atha kho brahmā Sanaṃkumāro samanuñño me satthā ti Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
